# PP: same-path copy of vanilla's disaster, written by `uv run ppc disasters apply` (src/prosper_or_perish_constructor/disaster_breaking_point.py); do not edit.
twilight_of_the_tsardom = {

	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/twilight_of_the_tsardom.dds"
	
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique

	can_start = {
		pp_disaster_restart_allowed_trigger = { type = twilight_of_the_tsardom } # PP: breaking point

		tag = BUL
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		current_year < 1338
	}
	
	fire_only_once = yes
	
	can_end = { # PP: breaking point: vanilla's way out, or the breaking point
		OR = {
			AND = {
		twilight_of_the_tsardom_end_trigger = yes
	}
			pp_disaster_breaking_point_trigger = { type = twilight_of_the_tsardom }
		}
	}
	
	modifier = {
		global_estate_target_satisfaction = big_permanent_target_satisfaction_penalty
		monthly_rebel_growth = 0.003
		global_monthly_control = -0.0005
		global_manpower_modifier = -0.3
		regiment_recruit_speed = -0.3
		discipline = -0.10
		land_morale_modifier = -0.10
		global_institution_growth_modifier = -0.5
		global_mercenaries_modifier = -0.5
		monthly_prestige = -0.5
		monthly_legitimacy = -0.3
		country_cabinet_efficiency = -0.2
		research_speed_modifier = -0.5
	}
	
	on_start = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = twilight_of_the_tsardom.1
	}
	
	on_end = { # PP: breaking point: past it without vanilla's way out, vanilla's end without the reward, then the blow
		if = {
			limit = {
				pp_disaster_breaking_point_trigger = { type = twilight_of_the_tsardom }
				NOT = { AND = {
		twilight_of_the_tsardom_end_trigger = yes
	} }
			}
			if = {
			limit = {
				owns = location:constantinople
				is_regional_power = yes
			}
			
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owns = location:constantinople
			}
			
		}	
		else = {
			
		}
			every_owned_location = { limit = { has_location_modifier = bul_powerful_local_elites } remove_location_modifier = bul_powerful_local_elites }
			pp_disaster_breaking_point_effect = { type = twilight_of_the_tsardom }
		}
		else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owns = location:constantinople
				is_regional_power = yes
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = twilight_of_the_tsardom.4
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owns = location:constantinople
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = twilight_of_the_tsardom.3
		}	
		else = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = twilight_of_the_tsardom.2
		}
	}
		pp_disaster_escalation_cleanup_effect = { type = twilight_of_the_tsardom }
	}
	
	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			10 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			90 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			random_list = {
				2 = { trigger_event_silently = twilight_of_the_tsardom.5 }
				2 = { trigger_event_silently = twilight_of_the_tsardom.6 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = twilight_of_the_tsardom.7 }
				2 = { trigger_event_silently = twilight_of_the_tsardom.8 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = twilight_of_the_tsardom.9 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = twilight_of_the_tsardom.10 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = twilight_of_the_tsardom.11 }
				90 = { }
				#More non-generic events related to the disaster are located in events/flavor_BUL
			}
		}
		# PP: breaking point
		pp_disaster_escalation_effect = { type = twilight_of_the_tsardom }
	}
}
